notes.title: RELEASE DAY!
notes.content:
Dear gamers,

Thank you for the wait. Aegis Dilemma: Veritas Omnia Vincit is now released! I hope you will enjoy this short story and peak your interest in the world of Aegis Dilemma.

This is my first visual novel and many mistakes were made, many lessons were learnt. I spent approximately 40 hours to make everything work, from the initial planning to the release stage on steam. Many mistakes were made but many were learnt. I will take the lessons for the 2nd installment (it will be bigger and expands greatly on the story on Aegis Dilemma).

I will give more updates as needed. Thank you and I wish you fun and a Merry Christmas ahead!!!
